sql: SELECT SUM(v) FILTER (WHERE v > 0) AS positive_sum, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS NULL) AS missing FROM (VALUES (CAST(-1 AS BIGINT)), (2), (CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)), (3)) AS t(v)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v > 99) AS count_empty, SUM(v) FILTER (WHERE v > 99) AS sum_empty FROM (VALUES (1), (2)) AS t(v)
